text:
Update:
I loved this washer, while it worked. I’ve only had it since October and it no longer drains. Spin dryer smells like burning plastic. It was saving me time and money when it worked. Now I’m back to having to wait at night to use the community machines. Can’t get it down the stairs alone or ship it back as it has shipping costs roughly $100+. Very disappointed and can’t say I would recommend to anyone. Filed a claim and will see if they can do anything. Doesn’t look good after reading other reviews.

Original:

I absolutely love this washer! Cleans clothes very well. It’s more work but for me it is worth it. I donated my washer and dryer a few years ago when I moved out of state. My apartment community only has 4 washers and 4 dryers for over 300 residents. I was having issues being able to clean clothes before it got dark outside. I’m a widowed mom of 2. It’s been nerve wrecking having to wash clothes late at night in a dark area. Going to the laundromat gets expensive and takes up my entire day. I’m saving so much time and money being able to wash at night or any time.
You can fill this with a lot of clothes. Even though it has a built in pump it’s still easier on the system if you place it off the ground. It’s also not recommended to use the drain function and spin dryer at the same time.
This washer can stretch out collars on some shirts. I put mine in laundry bags to help cut down on that. Also the lint trap doesn’t work well. I

Oh my gosh. I love this thing. I live upstairs in an apartment and I hate laundry day. The lugging the laundry for a family of 4 and paying for each load. It’s the worst.

I mentioned this to my boyfriend as a joke and he took the idea and ran with it. I am so glad we did! He was so excited to do laundry that I haven’t had to do it for over a month, and that’s a total win in my book! It’s so quiet I can fall asleep while he’s doing it. I have recommended it to so many people so far!

This washer really helped me out. I live in an apartment so I hate going to the laundry mat BUT the hose that attaches to the sink doesn't stay on and falls off so I have to fill it up with a bucket and Watch it constantly. If it wasn't for that this would get 5 stars but because of that sometimes especially during the winter I just go to the laundry mat.
What a great buy for us...no more waiting and frustation in waiting for your turn to use the coin laundry in our apartment complex. Thumbs up for us.

It’s a very dependable and durable small washing machine. It’s a very crafty and good at washing clothes. Only thing bad, our towels and some of our clothes have lent on them, once we wash. But overall it’s a very good machine to have if you live in a small apartment or dorm complex

This portable washer machine is great! Especially for me with a family of four we are actually saving time and money and the build in pomp is helping a lot. But that is not even the the best part, when you use some good detergent like Tide in combination with this washer you get an amazing result. But it also has some inconvenient like the spinner shakes the whole machine and can be disturbing for you and your neighbor, so a steadier spinner will help, also a bathroom faucet hose adapter should be provided to easy the water supply. I had to buy a separate water hose so it can be easier for my pregnant wife to do laundry on her own.( see attached picture).I have been using it now for about 2 months now and I think I already save more than what I bought this washer for. I will already advised my friends to get it

I absolutely love my Della! I replaced my front loading Maytag washer for this one and I love it. I don't think I will ever go back to the full size washers. My favorite thing about this washer is being able to see how clean the rinse water is. I definitely know that my clothes are clean. I have already recommended this washer to everyone that I know that is needing a washer for their apartment, RV, or they are in need of a replacement like I was.
The water inlet hose is too narrow for my tap. Anyway I can’t connect.

This was twice the size ive thought it would be dont even have to bend over just to put clothes in it and i can fit my king size blanket inside this by it self of course and im good at making it fit in the spinner without any problems i love that this has a built in pump thats a plus cause i dont have to prop it up to let the hose down for the water to drain i can just keep the hose attached to my washer and let the water drain upwards and into the tolet without the hose touching toilet water it got me and my children clothes clean smelling fresh and looking good washes better than a regular size i guess cause it dont have that middle part and the agitation is amazing but dont put way to many clothes in it it only makes the washer work harder instead of smart hope this helps someone

This machine is by far the absolute best thing to have. It’s small and can handle a lot. I was able to wash a queen sized comforter in this and it came out completely clean. The spin dryer is by far the thing that amazes me the most. In 5 mins it made that queen sized comforter very lightly damp. I hung it to dry and it was dry maybe in an hour. My advice is to wash more small loads because you’ll get the clothes dryer that way. Don’t overload this bad boy.

My only problem is the hose to fill the drum up with. It doesn’t like to stay hooked onto the faucet so I think if you modified the hose with some hardware store supplies it’ll be perfect. The same hose also doesn’t provide a solid seal on the back of the machine so it’ll drip a bit but nothing too major.

All in all, this is the absolute best investment you can ever get in my opinion.

First time when I bought this mashine it worked for just a few times.. then the water won’t to come out when I put it on drain and when I use the spiner... They send me another one, now after 5 months the same problem. Not satisfied with this product while I need to search for another one all the time.

So I purchase this a couple of months ago because I was tired of having a lot of clothes to wash , and I wash twice a week using this machine and all my clothes are caught up , I love have it can hold a lot of clothes unlike other portable machines on the market , only thing I find wrong is the hose to the machine is a little cheap and does leak water so just place a towel on the bottom of washer
We were very excited to try this in our apartment. The wash cycle worked nicely, but the dry spin did not work. It left a strong smell of burnt plastic. Returning this item. What a shame.

*Update* - 07/25/19 - It's now been over a year (Bought in May 2018) since I had this unit and it's still going strong. Nothing to complain about and I haven't had any issues (touch wood!). Still highly recommend.

Original Review:
I bought this after moving from the suburbs and into the city and losing my in-house washer/dryer. I was tired of going to the laundromats and wasting time when I could be doing something else. The only challenge initially for the washer was where to place it. Where I had a outlet, was not near my water source, so using the intake hoses was out of the question. You can buy an adapter to our tub faucet (as long as it doesn't have a pin top), but if you can't, you will have to haul water to the unit. I solved this with a funnel under my tub faucet and a 5 gallon tank (3 fill ups will hit max. level in the washer).

The washer is pretty big, but you will have learn that your "dryer" will only be able to accommodate half of the max. your washer will hold. So, if you wash the max level, you will have to divide your wash in two dryer loads. The downside to the washer it that you can't use hot water in the unit due to the plastic parts. I have gotten away with lukewarm water, but it was barely warm. I've had my unit for seven months now and you do have to figure out how much detergent you will need. You will more than likely use waaaay too much that is needed in the beginning. Right now I know that if I use a shot glass and a ha

I was very surprised to find out just how powerful this portable washer actually is. Very strong agitation for the size and price. Still a bit concerned about the main wall in the washing area being just a single sheet of plastic, seems like if an an accidental bump or kick could crack it and would render the entire machine useless.
I love this so much. It has brought freedom from crowded laundromats This is great.
very satisfactory
It was an easy hook up and it's very simple to use.

[[VIDEOID:c7c04de225815c6d2eb7e4b67a8514f7]] It’s a great Maxine so far,  I do recommend purchasing the four year protection plan just for that extra coverage  I just got this in the mail today I’ve been doing laundry all day it’s been a great machine so far I do recommend filling up the water with your shower hose or a bucket  And draining the water in your toilet is the easiest  It beats going to the laundromat three times a week! This will cut my costs in half!

After a few loads I'm very happy with this washer dryer! I hooked it up to the cold line and drain with a 4 foot hose, works perfectly. Definitely worth the price, I also purchased the extended warranty. I recommend this to anyone needing to escape the laundry mat! Will update every month!

We love these wonderful machines this is our second one purchased this was a surprise holiday gift for our daughter she's loving it as well wish we could have found them years ago would have saved soo much money I highly recommend these machines if your into saving money and for me I don't miss lugging laundry up 3 flights of stairs
Product works as described in products description.....

Didn't like bought two of these one for both of my daughters. One the lid had crack in corner and when you plug it in it'll make a buzzing noise and trips breaker. The second one only washes in one direction as opposed to agitating in both directions. So I was very disappointed after having bought two which both have problems
The washer is excellent. But the spinner stopped workingmy. It us not even 3 months... I used less than a dozen tImes.  I can't even find if it can be repaired.

Love it. My washer litterally exploded so i needed something and this does the trick. I wash my families clothes and it does more then you think then spin then jnto the regular dryer. The hose is flimsy but was able to get a vinyl tube and hose piece and a dishwasher po iece to hook oik t up. The down side is my spout broke jn the machine but j usuallu drape it over the egde anyways. And as god the drain i gravved my old washer plastic piece to sit it over the edge and it works.

great machine, does as advertised.
however, the drain hose is on the left and could be easier to use if it was centrally located to drain on either side. for the layout I have, I have to move the machine around to drain it. Same Problem with the plug; it's on the right and would be easier to use if centrally located. I have to use an extension cord. The machine is all plastic. One giant Plastic tub. Be very kind to it or the leaks are a nightmare. The drainage hose gets clogged and slow if you wash anything too linty in the machine. I recommend filling and draining simultaneously to remove access lint/clog, or wash your towels in a real washer/dryer. This machine is very loud; jet plane landing in your bathroom loud. It's also heavy. When empty the machine weights over 40 pounds. It is also Large and cumbersome, make sure you have a place to put it. Do not place it on a counter or platform, the machine vibrations will cause it to fall. There are holes in the back to fill the wash tub, but it is easier and faster to fill it with a bucket or lead the fill hose into the basin itself and not the rear fill hole. Rinse twice if you don't want stiff clothes. Spin between wash and rinse is optional but helpful. Spin basket shouldn't be more than half full when used, or the clothes will stay wet and the spinner will be unbalanced and bang loudly on the sides. If this happens, unplug the machine until the timer ends, unload and reload spinner and try again. Bed sheets come out pra

I just love this machine. It has quite a powerful motor on both the washer and dryer. It also has a very large tub. No matter how dirty, the clothes always come out clean and in only 15 minutes.
People say if the dryer makes noise it's because the clothes are unbalanced but I find that it actually wants MORE clothes. When I add more clothes, you can't believe how quiet and powerful the motor is.
I rinse my clothes in clean water going through another wash cycle but with less water and using much less time. The hoses are very flimsy, so it's best to get maybe a hair washing hose and let the water go into the tub. I use my washer at the kitchen sink and hook the drain hose in the sink as well. I just push my dish pan against it to hold it in. No problems.
I store my machine in my pantry with the hoses in the machine, leaving the washer door slightly ajar. You cant beat this for apartment washing and smaller loads make it convient to seperate clothing into sweaters, delicates, whites and my granddaughters clothing with all the sequins and all their red Christmas pajamas. Thank you Della for this exquisite machine.
Product works well and my wife like it

[[VIDEOID:52f8abf2b34da92a3a6d1c27734d4739]] Love it.  Gets clothes clean.  I can choose my own temp exactly by the water I put in.  I can choose the amount of times I choose to rinse.  Really a great product.  Only downside is storing between uses.

I wish that there was no stars for this product

Good quality, good value and gets a full load done no problem.

This is a 7-month review. The washer part is very effective and gets the clothes super duper clean, however spinner rarely ever works. The only time the spinner really worked was on the first use. After that it would not spin fast enough to wring out clothes so I had to end up wringing each one by hand. The only reason I've kept it this long is because, when I fianally realized the spinner was not working efficiently, the 30 day return window had already passed and I didn't get the warranty plan. I've been trying to get my $159 worth, but laundry has become more a hassle than going to the public laundromat. If you do try this machine please get the warranty.

I’ve used this product at least 10 times now. The hose from the base of the washer does not connect to the hose to hook to a sink faucet and that’s ok. We are using it in our kitchen with the hose and wash pin this came with adapting to our sink faucet directly to the washer tank from the top. We fill it from the top of the washer part with soap and then add clothes. We then wash.. then empty it into a bucket from the hose at the bottom. We stop the drain process and empty it then continue to fill the bucket again and repeat emptying. Once it’s done we fill with straight water to rinse and repeat the draining process. It’s very manual for this if you do it in the kitchen but we have to since it won’t fit in our bathroom.

The dryer part holds about 3 parts of the washing part. It’s so fast to spin before the water is sucked from the clothes. They don’t come out completely dry but only a little damp so we hang our clothes on a drying rack overnight and they’re done.

Our only complaint is the clothes come out wrinkly after drying on a rack but we just iron them.

We really love this machine. We live in a small nyc apartment and it saves us from going to a laundromat. Our electric bill has not increased at all and we are using this 5 times a month.

But I hope they either restock or else get a bigger one that also has the built in pump.(most of the other ones listed do not have a built in pump they only have a gravity drain). Please restock because I know that if anything happens to this one I will definitely be either upgrading to a bigger one or else buying the same one. Buy this machine if u can't get to the laundromat, u will not regret it!

I live in a second floor apartment and the laundry is downstairs. I whip this out, hook it up and save $3.00 for every load! Washes better than the regular washing machine in my opinion. The spinner gets things pretty close to dry, doesn't take long to hang dry them at all. Does cause a few wrinkles, but a quick go over with a steamer solves that!

This washer has been a fantastic investment for us. The apartment we moved into had super unreliable washers that were $2 to wash and $2 to dry. We hang dry most of our clothes anyway because we're runners and take good care of expensive running clothes. I had experience with a washer like this before purchasing so I felt confident, and it's worked fantastically. Loading the spin dryer the proper amount is key--too much or two little clothing and the spin receptacle will bang off the walls of the machine. Another important thing to keep in mind is that the agitator really only works well when the washer is at most 3/4 full. Also I always drain the machine by lifting it up and tipping excess water into the tub through the drain hose after most of the water has been pumped out--there's always a bit left and you don't want it sitting there. I store it with the lids propped open as well to reduce mildew smell.
absolutely wonderful!!! best buy in a very long time

I have a tiny house and this washer/dryer is just perfect. I just suggest listening for your pump sounds as the dryer pump runs hard but doesn't need to run that hard! I also suggest getting external lint traps. I have dogs and needed them.
Great !

Last year, I found myself living in a place that didn't allow for a regular washer.  For that reason, I was looking for a portable washer.  I picked this one, as it had the largest capacity I could find.  This machine has been wonderful.  It arrived quickly and well packaged.  I set it up and have it drain into the shower drain.  It has worked flawlessly for over a year.  It does everything from small items to large blanket/bedding items.  I was skeptical about these machines before, as they don't look like they are as durable and capable as regular ones.  After one year of use, except for the fact that it is more work than a traditional washer; this machine does everything a regular one can.  It's easy to use, with everything coming out clean.  It is also semi-dry thanks to a really powerful spinner.  You can wash large items without issue.  If you are in the market for one of these,  I would strongly recommend you consider it.  You can get a smaller one; but, you can do less loads and/or bigger items in this one.  It has seen a year of good service and continues to work well.
Love this washer!! Good value for the money!
hold enough clothes and if it comes out clean clothes, it depends a lot on the detergent you use. The only thing I don't like is the drain hose that should be thicker.

I ordered this filter as a replacement for the brand that I have used for well over 10 years in a Whirlpool refrigerator hoping to save money over that brand.  During the winter my well water has a very fine sedimen (much like talcum powder)  which stays suspended in the water until the ground warms up in early summer.  The Aquacrest filter was much less expensive but it did not filter out that sediment at all.  I have returned to my previous brand that filters it all out.  Contacted Amazon and have a full refund pending awaiting the return of the Aquacrest filters.  Great customer service from Amazon, but the product did not perform as well as I needed.

I found this item after searching through many listings for a similar product.  I read the reviews, compared the prices, and felt like if I had any problems with this particular item then the seller would make it right, so I took the chance! With a 20% off discount they offered I was able to get two 3-packs of this water filter for LESS than the price of ONE of the name brand filters! They arrived quickly, and even though the connector tip looked slightly different from the name brand filter I was removing, it still clicked in PERFECTLY with no leaks or problems. I got this to replace a Kenmore 9915 in a refrigerator that is about 17 years old. I figured 6 of these filters will carry me to the 20 year mark, so that should do! I have never used anything but the name brand filter, therefore I really did not change it as often as recommended due to the expense. I have already recommended this Aquacrest filter to my friends and family, and I do so to YOU as well!
